## Class: Book Quiz

Enter your name, answer the statements and submit. Your answers go to Ian.

:::: {#class-quiz}
{{< include _pvalue_quiz.qmd >}}
::::

```{=html}
<div class="submit-row">
  <input id="student-name" type="text" placeholder="Your name">
  <button id="submit-quiz" type="button">Submit</button>
  <span id="submit-status"></span>
</div>

<style>
  /* in class, hide Ian's "Show Answers" button and score */
  #class-quiz .webex-check-button,
  #class-quiz .webex-total_correct { display: none; }
</style>

<script>
// Google Form "mailbox": where to send, and the ID of each field
const FORM_URL = "https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdLNK9K0bkgpj-95ExjDQhD4rGqUqWhcj3e4J-CXVY3TXtY8A/formResponse";
const NAME_ID  = "entry.293074322";
const S_IDS    = ["entry.109706531", "entry.1155878693", "entry.1542228748",
                  "entry.1549731053", "entry.1995953686", "entry.1562067731"];
const SCORE_ID = "entry.986173425";

document.getElementById("submit-quiz").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const status  = document.getElementById("submit-status");
  const name    = document.getElementById("student-name").value.trim();
  const selects = document.querySelectorAll("#class-quiz select.webex-select");

  // the chosen text of each dropdown ("TRUE", "FALSE" or "" if not answered)
  const answers = [...selects].map(s => s.options[s.selectedIndex].text.trim());

  if (!name)                  { status.textContent = "Please enter your name."; return; }
  if (answers.includes(""))   { status.textContent = "Please answer all 6 statements."; return; }

  // webexercises marks the correct option with value "answer"
  const score = [...selects].filter(s => s.value === "answer").length;

  const data = new URLSearchParams();
  data.append(NAME_ID, name);
  answers.forEach((a, i) => data.append(S_IDS[i], a));
  data.append(SCORE_ID, score);

  status.textContent = "Sending…";
  try {
    await fetch(FORM_URL, { method: "POST", mode: "no-cors", body: data });
    status.textContent = "✓ Submitted. Thank you!";
  } catch (e) {
    status.textContent = "Couldn't submit. Please check your connection and try again.";
  }
});
</script>
```

:::
